{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black structured blazer, tailored fit, hip length, deep obsidian, wool blend with a subtle matte finish.
Crisp white button-down shirt, classic cut, knee length when tucked, pure bright white, cotton poplin.
High-waisted black trousers, straight leg, ankle length, jet black, heavy weight twill.
Black leather loafers, standard width, mid-calf height, glossy black, smooth calfskin.
A sleek black clutch, rectangular shape, short handle, matte black, grained leather.
This outfit perfectly balances the "restrained and classic" request with a rock concert setting by using a sharp blazer to add structure against the energetic atmosphere. The monochromatic black-on-black palette ensures she stands out with an air of cool sophistication rather than blending in with the crowd. While a jacket is included for potential evening chill, the outfit remains lightweight enough to layer or remove as temperatures shift inside the venue."}
